definitions: A plan or drawing produced to show the look and function or workings of a building, garment, or other object before it is built or made.
The art or action of conceiving of and producing a plan or drawing.
A purpose, planning, or intention that exists behind an action, fact, or material object.
examples: The design of the new car is very sleek.
She studied graphic design at university.
There was a clear design behind his actions.
